title: Measuring Whether Emergent Misalignment Affects Chain-of-Thought Reasoning Before Visible Outputs

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Tests whether CoT monitoring could serve as early warning for misalignment. If CoT is misaligned before outputs, it enables oversight. If outputs are misaligned without CoT, it reveals misalignment bypasses reasoning, a critical finding for safety.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires finetuning a reasoning-capable model, which may be harder than standard models. Manual scoring of CoT misalignment adds subjective labeling work. Automated scoring of CoT alignment is non-trivial for beginners.

narrow_scope.reasoning: One finetuning run plus evaluation with CoT analysis. The manual/automated scoring of CoT reasoning adds scope. Deliverable is clear (CoT vs output misalignment comparison) but annotation work could be time-consuming.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
